name: Bardsey
text: Bardsey is an island off the coast of Wales, called Ynys Enlli in Welsh. It lies at the mouth of a great bay and is small in size. According to the Triads, the wise figure Merlin kept a glass house there with the Treasures of Britain. In the sixth century the saint Cadfan founded a monastery on the island.

attributes.attribute: an island off the Welsh coast
site of a monastery of Cadfan
